svg.title: M3: one reader, null output and retained reference. The normalized matched-template prescription in [7, pp. 18–21] and [8, Section 32, pp. 42–43] informs the template choice; the absorbing dynamics and complete instrument are specified here. Let |r⟩be a normalized template in a finite source space and Π = |r⟩⟨r|. Fix a duration T ≥0 in seconds and a rate κ ≥0 in s−1, and set the dimensionless α = κT, η = 1 −e−α.
